name: dual-core-1
written_before: any E1 score; one execution-only smoke run of L1000 fold 0 printed row counts and runtime only (no metric was computed or read)
exposure: development screen. SciPlex3 and GSE92742 L1000 have been read in every block since 2026-09-26, including block 6's E-WM1/E-WM2 on the same folds; GSE70138 was opened in block 2 and is not used here. Nothing here is external or confirmatory.
primary_question: When MAESTRO has bought one or more response profiles of a compound, can those purchased profiles be used as quality-aware in-context evidence to predict its response at unmeasured conditions while retaining compound-specific signal, and can the agent act on selection-calibrated risk?

hypotheses.world_model: A1: rrt_q (low-rank transition plus a quality-weighted compound-specific residual) discriminates held-out compounds better than block 6's ridge_st without losing direction; A2: inverse inner-CV-error aggregation of per-prompt predictions beats equal weighting on direction without losing discrimination.
hypotheses.agent: Frozen separately in protocol_e2.json before any E2 score: a planner whose abstention threshold is chosen by Learn-then-Test on calibration folds' selected actions controls held-out wrong-elimination risk where the unmodified planner does not.
hypotheses.interaction: Frozen with the agent hypothesis: the in-context world model and the risk-controlled policy together give a better risk-coverage trade-off than either alone (calibration and risk outcomes only; E-DATA1's failure rule blocks decision-value claims).

closest_prior_art.Hodos et al. 2018, PSB, doi:10.1142/9789: L1000 cross-cell-line prediction of a drug's profile from its profiles elsewhere by kNN and tensor completion; our A1/A2 regime is the same task family, so the transfer backbone is adaptation, not novelty
closest_prior_art.Szalata et al. 2024, NeurIPS Datasets an: predict held-out cell types' chemical responses from measured cell types
closest_prior_art.Adduri et al. 2026, Cell 189:5914, doi:1: learned state transition across contexts; ridge_st is a linear analogue
closest_prior_art.Dong et al. 2026, bioRxiv v2, doi:10.648: measured cells of a condition as an inference-time prompt
closest_prior_art.Vinas Torne et al. 2025, Nat Biotechnol,: metrics must separate perturbation-specific effects from systematic variation; hence centred direction and discrimination as co-primary
closest_prior_art.Ahlmann-Eltze et al. 2025, Nat Methods,: simple linear baselines are strong; hence strict baselines

units.sciplex3: InChIKey connectivity block (stored as 'skeleton'); 10 Murcko scaffolds (26 compounds) span folds and form a sensitivity stratum
units.l1000: identity/Murcko-scaffold connected component; no scaffold spans folds

data.feature_space: fixed in advance, not learned from outcomes: SciPlex3 2,473 genes chosen from vehicle controls; L1000 978 landmarks
data.gene_sets: MSigDB Hallmark: SciPlex3 frozen gene_sets.json; L1000 h.all.v2024.1 mapped through GSE92742 gene_info; sets with >= 5 members
data.prompt_quality: SciPlex3 split-half replicate Pearson; L1000 cc_q75; clipped to [0, 1]

E1.inner: 4 group folds by independent unit (sha256-dealt), every outcome-dependent component refitted per inner split

regimes.A0: no measured response of the query compound
regimes.A2: two purchased prompts, up to 10 seeded pairs per (compound, target)

E1.items_scored: targets detected (a response distinguishable from vehicle) for direction, discrimination, Pearson delta, gene-set and phenocopy metrics; all items for MSE and the effect AUROC

primary.A1: rrt_q - ridge_st: discrimination (State, Manhattan, normalised rank among the fold's held-out truths at the target) with 95% unit-bootstrap interval above 0, AND centred cosine (direction) with interval lower bound above -margin
primary.A2: rrt_precision - rrt_mean: centred cosine with interval above 0, AND discrimination with interval lower bound above -margin

E1.aggregation: unit mean (each unit's items averaged first), 10,000-draw unit-cluster bootstrap, seed 20260927, per dataset; a component is kept only if its rule passes on both datasets
secondary: item-weighted sensitivity of the primary comparisons
rrt_q versus additive and prompt copy
controls: shuffled prompt, wrong-target transition (expected worse than rrt_q)
A0: chemical ridge and kNN versus context mean
A2 precision versus best single prompt
strata: relation (dose, time, line), prompt detected, effect-size tertile of the truth, SciPlex3 compounds whose Murcko scaffold does not span folds
E1.keep_rules: rrt_q replaces ridge_st as the transfer source only if the A1 rule passes on both datasets; precision aggregation is kept only if the A2 rule passes on both; otherwise the component is rejected or reported as dataset-specific

E2: frozen in research/dual_core/protocol_e2.json before any E2 score
claims_not_allowed: decision value or planner superiority on these data (E-DATA1 failure rule)
that a predicted profile is an observed result
